Python with class and functions, verify symbol count

```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"
import io.xberg.tslp.android.*
import com.fasterxml.jackson.module.kotlin.jacksonObjectMapper

fun main() {
    val mapper = jacksonObjectMapper().setPropertyNamingStrategy(com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.PropertyNamingStrategies.SNAKE_CASE)
    val config = mapper.readValue("{\"language\":\"python\",\"symbols\":true}", ProcessConfig::class.java)
    val result = TreeSitterLanguagePack.process("MY_CONST = 42\ndef helper(): pass\nclass Widget: pass\n", config)
    println(result.language)
    println(result.symbols)
}
```
